content.bridge_context: Building on basic shape recognition from Grade 6, we introduce the concept of 'Congruence' - shapes that are exact twins.

units.title: What is Congruence?
units.explanation: Two shapes are congruent if they have the same shape and same size. They fit exactly over each other.
units.dual_language_instruction: Find two identical objects in your room. / अपने कमरे में दो एक जैसी चीज़ें खोजें।

units.title: Congruence of Line Segments
units.explanation: Two line segments are congruent if they have the same length.
units.dual_language_instruction: Measure two 5cm lines. / दो 5 सेमी की रेखाओं को मापें।
